action.instructions: What to do with this content. Apply policy precedence: illegal/safety > remove > warn > allow. Abstain when there is no interpretable content.

criteria.allow: Civil content including harsh product criticism — 'this is garbage', 'worst update ever'
criteria.warn: Borderline — profanity at a product, NSFW-adjacent links, spammy self-promo
criteria.remove: Severe but not illegal — targeted harassment, slurs, hate speech, 'kill yourself'
criteria.escalate_human: Potentially illegal or safety-critical — drug/weapon offers, credible threats, minor safety, self-harm encouragement

criteria: Benign — civil, criticism, profanity not aimed at a person; 'crap update', 'this sucks'
Borderline — insults, suggestive content, spammy promo; 'you're an idiot', 'check my link'
Severe — threats, hate speech, illegal offers, safety risk; 'I know where you live', 'selling oxycodone'. Does NOT count: rudeness or profanity alone (that's level 1 at most)

illegal_or_safety.instructions: True only when content may be illegal or a safety risk: controlled substances, weapons, credible threats, minor safety, self-harm. Profanity or rudeness alone does NOT count.
